text.name: Adamantine Shield
text.description: Gives all friendly targets +25% damage resistance. It also gives the hero +3 Defense.
text.event: You met an old man and agreed to give him a ride to his son's house, where he could die in peace. Unfortunately, the house turned out to be empty; no one had lived in it for many years. Not finding the son, you remained with the old man in his hour of death. In the last minutes before his death, the old man told you to take his Adamantine Shield for yourself.
